som.text: Lumengrid, the former capital of the vedalken, is the place where leaders of the Neurok and the vedalken reach an uneasy truce, trading serum for knowledge.
Glissa kills the Pontifex there, only to have the true culprit revealed, and Lumengrid is then taken and converted into a research center for compleation experiments.

Jin-Gitaxias converts the topmost chamber into his laboratory to realize the Great Synthesis, and Politus is captured and compleated during the assimilation and helps convert the city into a multi-tiered facility.
Kara enters the Phyrexianized Lumengrid and survives without compleation.
